planets.name: TOI-1272 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1272 with a 3.32-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1272 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1272. Its orbit and size follow Mancini et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
